maximum_depth_rule: All nine canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until the fourteen major goals, one hundred sixty KPIs, values, periods, units, and publication-version relationships can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
hierarchy_boundary: The fourteen major goals and one hundred sixty KPIs remain separate hierarchy levels. Draft-outline publications and the adopted strategy remain separate versions, and duplicate publication rows do not increase the canonical record count.
evaluation_boundary: The post-earthquake creative-recovery plan does not overwrite the original growth-strategy targets. Annual forward-or-backward statuses remain official evaluation classifications rather than independent achievement judgments.
non_goals: Do not count duplicate draft and adopted publication rows as new policy records.
Do not fill the zero-row major-goal and KPI document with inferred records.
Do not merge fourteen major goals and one hundred sixty KPIs into one layer.
Do not overwrite strategy targets with the post-earthquake recovery plan.
Do not convert official progress classifications into independent achievement scores.
Do not replace missing units or split mixed values by inference.
Do not calculate causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
